name: hooks-bash-safety
description: Bash safety guards tuned for autonomous agents: hard-block only unrecoverable ops (rm -rf / or $HOME root, mkfs, dd to a real block device, sandbox-bypass flag). dd to pseudo-devices (/dev/null, /dev/zero, etc.) is allowed. curl|sh pipes emit a non-blocking warn (allow + advisory). sudo paired with destructive verbs warns. rm -rf defers to rm-rf-guard: project-local and temp-dir cleanups silent; unexpanded $var targets denied; ~/subpath and outside-tree paths warn (non-blocking); quoted bypass forms and flags-after-target denied. Matching anchored to command position. No "ask" ever emitted. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).
